title: Vlad and Shapes
statementMd:
Vladislav has a binary square grid of $n \times n$ cells. A triangle or a square is drawn on the grid with symbols $\texttt{1}$. As he is too busy being cool, he asks you to tell him which shape is drawn on the grid.

- A *triangle* is a shape consisting of $k$ ($k \gt 1$) consecutive rows, where the $i$-th row has $2 \cdot i-1$ consecutive characters $\texttt{1}$, and the central `1`s are located in one column. An upside down triangle is also considered a valid triangle (but not rotated by 90 degrees).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/60e200216d39737369e0de040da876b1658f30e2.png) Two left pictures contain examples of triangles: $k=4$, $k=3$. The two right pictures don't contain triangles.

- A *square* is a shape consisting of $k$ ($k \gt 1$) consecutive rows, where the $i$-th row has $k$ consecutive characters $\texttt{1}$, which are positioned at an equal distance from the left edge of the grid.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0fc6a91326a51da2c22e02c48e8eb2387384b0ef.png) Examples of two squares: $k=2$, $k=4$.

For the given grid, determine the type of shape that is drawn on it.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $t$ ($1 \leq t \leq 100$) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($2 \leq n \leq 10$) — the size of the grid.

The next $n$ lines each contain $n$ characters $\texttt{0}$ or $\texttt{1}$.

The grid contains exactly one triangle or exactly one square that contains all the $\texttt{1}$s in the grid. It is guaranteed that the size of the triangle or square is greater than $1$ (i.e., the shape cannot consist of exactly one `1`).

## Output

For each test case, output "`SQUARE`" if all the $\texttt{1}$s in the grid form a square, and "`TRIANGLE`" otherwise (without quotes).
statementZhMd:
弗拉迪斯拉夫有一个由 $n \times n$ 个单元格组成的二进制方格网格。网格上用符号 $\texttt{1}$ 绘制了一个三角形或正方形。由于他正忙着耍酷，所以请你告诉他网格上绘制的是哪种形状。

- *三角形* 是由 $k$（$k \gt 1$）行连续组成的图形，其中第 $i$ 行包含 $2 \cdot i-1$ 个连续的字符 $\texttt{1}$，并且中间的 `1` 位于同一列。倒三角形也被视为有效的三角形（但不能旋转 90 度）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/60e200216d39737369e0de040da876b1658f30e2.png) 左侧两幅图展示了三角形的例子：$k=4$、$k=3$。右侧两幅图中的图形不是三角形。

- *正方形* 是由 $k$（$k \gt 1$）行连续组成的图形，其中第 $i$ 行包含 $k$ 个连续的字符 $\texttt{1}$，并且这些字符到网格左边缘的距离相等。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0fc6a91326a51da2c22e02c48e8eb2387384b0ef.png) 两个正方形的例子：$k=2$、$k=4$。

对于给定的网格，确定其中绘制的形状类型。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \leq t \leq 100$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$2 \leq n \leq 10$）——网格的大小。

接下来的 $n$ 行每行包含 $n$ 个字符 $\texttt{0}$ 或 $\texttt{1}$。

网格中恰好包含一个三角形或一个正方形，并且网格中的所有 $\texttt{1}$ 都属于该图形。保证三角形或正方形的大小大于 $1$（即图形不能只由一个 `1` 组成）。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，如果网格中的所有 $\texttt{1}$ 组成一个正方形，则输出 `SQUARE`；否则输出 `TRIANGLE`（不含引号）。
